intro: Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze is a night elf guardian stationed in Auberdine along the misty coast of Darkshore. Operating from the upper floor of a lodge across the bridge, she monitors growing regional threats and directs travelers toward pressing concerns in the wilderness.

p: While many Sentinels patrol the foggy coastline and woodlands directly, Elissa Starbreeze coordinates defensive efforts from Auberdine. Stationed on the upper level of the building just northeast across the bridge from the town inn, she stays alert to unusual disturbances in Darkshore. Her tasks frequently point adventurers toward remote points of interest, including the mysterious Tower of Althalaxx looming far to the north, ensuring that shadowy incursions do not take the coastal settlement unawares.
